title: Abeon Organisation Member DTO
description: One row of an organisation's member list. Deliberately NOT a User DTO: `status` here is the status of the *membership*, and a person's standing in one organisation says nothing about their standing in another, or about the account itself. A schema that reused `dto/user.json` would make that distinction invisible to every consumer.

id.description: The user's id. There is no membership id on the wire — a membership is identified by (user, organisation), and the organisation is never a parameter.

status.description: The membership's status in THIS organisation. Never `users.status`.

roles.description: Role names within this organisation, not permissions. Permissions are resolved from roles at token issue and are not part of an administrative listing.
